paragraphs.en: pip install torch==2.8.0 torchvision==0.23.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128 PyTorch 2.8.0 is the recommended version because NVIDIA Kaolin (required by the batch rendering pipeline) has prebuilt wheels for torch-2.8.0_cu128 . paragraphs.en: FlashInfer provides paged KV cache attention for efficient streaming inference. It is a pure-Python package that JIT-compiles CUDA kernels on first use, so a single wheel works across CUDA/PyTorch versions:
paragraphs.zh: FlashInfer 提供分页 KV 缓存注意力机制，以实现高效的流式推理。 它是一个纯 Python 包，会在首次使用时即时编译 CUDA 内核，因此单个 wheel 包即可跨 CUDA/PyTorch 版本使用：

sents.en: FlashInfer provides paged KV cache attention for efficient streaming inference.
sents.zh: FlashInfer 提供分页 KV 缓存注意力机制，以实现高效的流式推理。

sents.en: It is a pure-Python package that JIT-compiles CUDA kernels on first use, so a single wheel works across CUDA/PyTorch versions:
sents.zh: 它是一个纯 Python 包，会在首次使用时即时编译 CUDA 内核，因此单个 wheel 包即可跨 CUDA/PyTorch 版本使用：

paragraphs.en: pip install --index-url https://pypi.org/simple flashinfer-python --index-url https://pypi.org/simple is only needed if your default pip index is an internal mirror that doesn't have flashinfer-python . (Optional) For faster first-use, you can additionally install a CUDA-specific JIT cache: pip install flashinfer-jit-cache -f https://flashinfer.ai/whl/cu128/flashinfer-jit-cache/ . See FlashInfer installation for details. If FlashInfer is not installed, the model falls back to SDPA (PyTorch native attention) via --use_sdpa .
paragraphs.zh: 仅当你的默认 pip 索引是一个没有 flashinfer-python 的内部镜像时，才需要使用 pip install --index-url https://pypi.org/simple flashinfer-python --index-url https://pypi.org/simple 。 （可选）为了加快首次使用速度，你还可以额外安装一个针对特定 CUDA 的 JIT 缓存：pip install flashinfer-jit-cache -f https://flashinfer.ai/whl/cu128/flashinfer-jit-cache/ 。 详情请参阅 FlashInfer 安装文档。 如果未安装 FlashInfer，模型会通过 --use_sdpa 回退到 SDPA（PyTorch 原生注意力机制）。

paragraphs.en: Dataset: Download the demo sequences from robbyant/lingbot-map-demo on Hugging Face.
paragraphs.zh: 数据集：从 Hugging Face 上的 robbyant/lingbot-map-demo 下载演示序列。

paragraphs.en: Example run on the dynamic sequence from the dataset above (sky masking on, 4 camera optimization iterations, keyframe every 2 frames):
paragraphs.zh: 示例运行：使用上方数据集中的动态序列（开启天空掩码，4 次相机优化迭代，每 2 帧取一个关键帧）：

paragraphs.en: Run the dynamic sequence with sky masking, 4 camera optimization iterations, and an input stride of 2:
paragraphs.zh: 运行带天空掩码（sky masking）、4 次相机优化迭代以及输入步长为 2 的动态序列：

paragraphs.en: python demo.py \ --image_folder /path/to/dynamic\ --model_path ../../Lingbot-Map/lingbot-map.pt \ --camera_num_iterations 4 \ --mask_sky \ --stride 2 output_pointcloud_side_by_side_under_10MB.mp4 Streaming with Keyframe Interval Use --keyframe_interval to reduce KV cache memory by only keeping every N-th frame as a keyframe. Non-keyframe frames still produce predictions but are not stored in the cache. This is useful for long sequences which exceed 320 frames (We train with video RoPE on 320 views, so performance degrades when the KV cache stores more than 320 views. Using a keyframe strategy allows inference over longer sequences.). In demo.py, the keyframe interval is calculated automatically.
paragraphs.zh: python demo.py \ --image_folder /path/to/dynamic\ --model_path ../../Lingbot-Map/lingbot-map.pt \ --camera_num_iterations 4 \ --mask_sky \ --stride 2 output_pointcloud_side_by_side_under_10MB.mp4 使用关键帧间隔进行流式处理 使用 --keyframe_interval 只保留每第 N 帧作为关键帧，从而减少 KV 缓存的内存占用。 非关键帧仍会产生预测结果，但不会存储在缓存中。 这对于超过 320 帧的长序列非常有用（我们使用视频 RoPE 在 320 个视图上进行训练，因此当 KV 缓存存储超过 320 个视图时，性能会下降。 使用关键帧策略可以对更长的序列进行推理。）。 在 demo.py 中，关键帧间隔是自动计算的。

sents.en: python demo.py \ --image_folder /path/to/dynamic\ --model_path ../../Lingbot-Map/lingbot-map.pt \ --camera_num_iterations 4 \ --mask_sky \ --stride 2 output_pointcloud_side_by_side_under_10MB.mp4 Streaming with Keyframe Interval Use --keyframe_interval to reduce KV cache memory by only keeping every N-th frame as a keyframe.
sents.zh: python demo.py \ --image_folder /path/to/dynamic\ --model_path ../../Lingbot-Map/lingbot-map.pt \ --camera_num_iterations 4 \ --mask_sky \ --stride 2 output_pointcloud_side_by_side_under_10MB.mp4 使用关键帧间隔进行流式处理 使用 --keyframe_interval 只保留每第 N 帧作为关键帧，从而减少 KV 缓存的内存占用。

sents.en: Non-keyframe frames still produce predictions but are not stored in the cache.
sents.zh: 非关键帧仍会产生预测结果，但不会存储在缓存中。

sents.en: This is useful for long sequences which exceed 320 frames (We train with video RoPE on 320 views, so performance degrades when the KV cache stores more than 320 views.
sents.zh: 这对于超过 320 帧的长序列非常有用（我们使用视频 RoPE 在 320 个视图上进行训练，因此当 KV 缓存存储超过 320 个视图时，性能会下降。

sents.en: Using a keyframe strategy allows inference over longer sequences.).
sents.zh: 使用关键帧策略可以对更长的序列进行推理。）。

sents.en: In demo.py, the keyframe interval is calculated automatically.
sents.zh: 在 demo.py 中，关键帧间隔是自动计算的。

paragraphs.en: Note on inference range. Our method does not perform state resetting by default, so the maximum inference range is bounded by the longest distance seen during training on the dataset. Beyond that distance, state resetting becomes necessary. If you observe pose collapse, switch to windowed mode ( --mode windowed ) — in most cases tuning --keyframe_interval alone is enough and the rest of the windowed parameters can stay at their defaults.
paragraphs.zh: 关于推理范围的说明。 我们的方法默认不执行状态重置，因此最大推理范围受限于训练时在数据集中见过的最长距离。 超过该距离后，状态重置就变得必要。 如果观察到位姿坍缩，请切换到窗口模式（ --mode windowed ）——在大多数情况下，只需调整 --keyframe_interval 即可，其余窗口模式参数保持默认值即可。

sents.en: Note on inference range.
sents.zh: 关于推理范围的说明。

sents.en: Our method does not perform state resetting by default, so the maximum inference range is bounded by the longest distance seen during training on the dataset.
sents.zh: 我们的方法默认不执行状态重置，因此最大推理范围受限于训练时在数据集中见过的最长距离。

sents.en: Beyond that distance, state resetting becomes necessary.
sents.zh: 超过该距离后，状态重置就变得必要。

sents.en: If you observe pose collapse, switch to windowed mode ( --mode windowed ) — in most cases tuning --keyframe_interval alone is enough and the rest of the windowed parameters can stay at their defaults.
sents.zh: 如果观察到位姿坍缩，请切换到窗口模式（ --mode windowed ）——在大多数情况下，只需调整 --keyframe_interval 即可，其余窗口模式参数保持默认值即可。

paragraphs.en: python demo.py --model_path /path/to/lingbot-map.pt \ --video_path video.mp4 --fps 10 \ --mode windowed --window_size 128 --overlap_keyframes 16 --keyframe_interval 2 Sky Masking Sky masking uses an ONNX sky segmentation model to filter out sky points from the reconstructed point cloud, which improves visualization quality for outdoor scenes.
paragraphs.zh: python demo.py --model_path /path/to/lingbot-map.pt \ --video_path video.mp4 --fps 10 \ --mode windowed --window_size 128 --overlap_keyframes 16 --keyframe_interval 2 天空掩码 天空掩码使用 ONNX 天空分割模型从重建的点云中滤除天空点，从而提升户外场景的可视化质量。

paragraphs.en: # Install onnxruntime (required) pip install onnxruntime # CPU # or pip install onnxruntime-gpu # GPU (faster for large image sets) By default, root demo.py resolves the sky segmentation model as skyseg.onnx relative to the current working directory. If that default file is missing, it is automatically downloaded from HuggingFace on first use. If the download fails or does not produce a regular file, sky masking stops with a RuntimeError that reports the model path, download URL, cause, and manual setup guidance; it never silently continues without masking.
paragraphs.zh: # 安装 onnxruntime（必需） pip install onnxruntime # CPU # 或者 pip install onnxruntime-gpu # GPU（处理大量图像时更快） 默认情况下，根目录下的 demo.py 会将天空分割模型解析为相对于当前工作目录的 skyseg.onnx。 如果该默认文件缺失，它会在首次使用时自动从 HuggingFace 下载。 如果下载失败或未能生成常规文件，天空遮罩处理将停止并抛出 RuntimeError，报告模型路径、下载 URL、原因以及手动设置指引；它绝不会在没有遮罩的情况下静默继续运行。

sents.en: # Install onnxruntime (required) pip install onnxruntime # CPU # or pip install onnxruntime-gpu # GPU (faster for large image sets) By default, root demo.py resolves the sky segmentation model as skyseg.onnx relative to the current working directory.
sents.zh: # 安装 onnxruntime（必需） pip install onnxruntime # CPU # 或者 pip install onnxruntime-gpu # GPU（处理大量图像时更快） 默认情况下，根目录下的 demo.py 会将天空分割模型解析为相对于当前工作目录的 skyseg.onnx。

sents.en: If that default file is missing, it is automatically downloaded from HuggingFace on first use.
sents.zh: 如果该默认文件缺失，它会在首次使用时自动从 HuggingFace 下载。

sents.en: If the download fails or does not produce a regular file, sky masking stops with a RuntimeError that reports the model path, download URL, cause, and manual setup guidance; it never silently continues without masking.
sents.zh: 如果下载失败或未能生成常规文件，天空遮罩处理将停止并抛出 RuntimeError，报告模型路径、下载 URL、原因以及手动设置指引；它绝不会在没有遮罩的情况下静默继续运行。

paragraphs.en: For manual recovery while keeping the default path, download skyseg.onnx into the directory from which you run demo.py :
paragraphs.zh: 如需在保持默认路径的情况下进行手动恢复，请将 skyseg.onnx 下载到你运行 demo.py 时所在的目录中：

paragraphs.en: wget -O skyseg.onnx https://huggingface.co/JianyuanWang/skyseg/resolve/main/skyseg.onnx python demo.py --model_path /path/to/checkpoint.pt \ --image_folder /path/to/images/ --mask_sky Usage with an explicit model path:
paragraphs.zh: wget -O skyseg.onnx https://huggingface.co/JianyuanWang/skyseg/resolve/main/skyseg.onnx python demo.py --model_path /path/to/checkpoint.pt \ --image_folder /path/to/images/ --mask_sky 使用显式模型路径进行推理：

paragraphs.en: To use a model stored elsewhere, pass its absolute path with --sky_model :
paragraphs.zh: 若要使用存储在其他位置的模型，请通过 --sky_model 传入其绝对路径：

paragraphs.en: python demo.py --model_path /path/to/checkpoint.pt \ --image_folder /path/to/images/ --mask_sky \ --sky_model /absolute/path/to/skyseg.onnx Sky masks are cached in <image_folder>_sky_masks/ so subsequent runs skip regeneration. You can also specify a custom cache directory with --sky_mask_dir , or save side-by-side mask visualizations with --sky_mask_visualization_dir :
paragraphs.zh: python demo.py --model_path /path/to/checkpoint.pt \ --image_folder /path/to/images/ --mask_sky \ --sky_model /absolute/path/to/skyseg.onnx 天空掩码会缓存到 <image_folder>_sky_masks/ 目录中，因此后续运行会跳过重新生成。 你还可以通过 --sky_mask_dir 指定自定义缓存目录，或通过 --sky_mask_visualization_dir 保存并排的掩码可视化结果：

sents.en: python demo.py --model_path /path/to/checkpoint.pt \ --image_folder /path/to/images/ --mask_sky \ --sky_model /absolute/path/to/skyseg.onnx Sky masks are cached in <image_folder>_sky_masks/ so subsequent runs skip regeneration.
sents.zh: python demo.py --model_path /path/to/checkpoint.pt \ --image_folder /path/to/images/ --mask_sky \ --sky_model /absolute/path/to/skyseg.onnx 天空掩码会缓存到 <image_folder>_sky_masks/ 目录中，因此后续运行会跳过重新生成。

sents.en: You can also specify a custom cache directory with --sky_mask_dir , or save side-by-side mask visualizations with --sky_mask_visualization_dir :
sents.zh: 你还可以通过 --sky_mask_dir 指定自定义缓存目录，或通过 --sky_mask_visualization_dir 保存并排的掩码可视化结果：

paragraphs.en: python demo.py --model_path /path/to/checkpoint.pt \ --image_folder /path/to/images/ --mask_sky \ --sky_mask_dir /path/to/cached_masks/ \ --sky_mask_visualization_dir /path/to/mask_viz/ Visualization Options Argument Default Description --port 8080 Viser viewer port --conf_threshold 1.5 Visibility threshold for filtering low-confidence points --point_size 0.00001 Point cloud point size --downsample_factor 10 Spatial downsampling for point cloud display Performance & Memory Without FlashInfer (SDPA fallback) python demo.py --model_path /path/to/checkpoint.pt \ --image_folder /path/to/images/ --use_sdpa Running on Limited GPU Memory If you run into out-of-memory issues, try one (or both) of the following:
paragraphs.zh: python demo.py --model_path /path/to/checkpoint.pt \ --image_folder /path/to/images/ --mask_sky \ --sky_mask_dir /path/to/cached_masks/ \ --sky_mask_visualization_dir /path/to/mask_viz/ 可视化选项 参数 默认值 描述 --port 8080 Viser 查看器端口 --conf_threshold 1.5 过滤低置信度点的可见性阈值 --point_size 0.00001 点云的点大小 --downsample_factor 10 点云显示的空间降采样因子 性能与内存 不使用 FlashInfer（回退到 SDPA） python demo.py --model_path /path/to/checkpoint.pt \ --image_folder /path/to/images/ --use_sdpa 在显存有限的 GPU 上运行 如果遇到显存不足（out-of-memory）的问题，请尝试以下一种（或两种）方法：

paragraphs.en: Lower the number of iterative refinement steps in the camera head to trade a small amount of pose accuracy for wall-clock speed:
paragraphs.zh: 降低相机头中迭代优化步骤的数量，以少量的姿态精度换取实际运行速度：

paragraphs.en: python demo.py --model_path /path/to/checkpoint.pt \ --image_folder /path/to/images/ --camera_num_iterations 1 --camera_num_iterations defaults to 4 ; setting it to 1 skips three refinement passes in the camera head (and shrinks its KV cache by 4×).
paragraphs.zh: python demo.py --model_path /path/to/checkpoint.pt \ --image_folder /path/to/images/ --camera_num_iterations 1 --camera_num_iterations 默认值为 4；将其设为 1 可跳过相机头中的三次精炼迭代（并将其 KV 缓存缩减至原来的 1/4）。

paragraphs.en: Use this pipeline when your sequence is too long for the interactive viser viewer — for example, the indoor walkthrough featured above . demo_render/batch_demo.py is the all-in-one offline entry point: feed it a video or a folder of images and it will run model inference and produce a headless point-cloud flythrough MP4 in a single command. It shares the same PyTorch / FlashInfer / checkpoint stack as demo.py .
paragraphs.zh: 当你的序列对于交互式 viser 查看器来说过长时，请使用此流水线——例如上方的室内漫游示例。demo_render/batch_demo.py 是一体化的离线入口：输入一段视频或一个图像文件夹，它将通过单条命令完成模型推理并生成无头（headless）的点云飞行穿越 MP4 视频。 它与 demo.py 共享相同的 PyTorch / FlashInfer / 检查点技术栈。

paragraphs.en: camera : fov : 60.0 # camera field of view in degrees transition : 30 # frames blended between adjacent segments segments : - mode : follow # chase cam following the input trajectory frames : [0, 1500] # rendered-frame range this segment covers (-1 = end) back_offset : 0.3 # how far behind the input camera (fraction of scene scale) up_offset : 0.08 # vertical lift above the input camera look_offset : 0.4 # how far ahead the lookat target points smooth_window : 30 # trajectory smoothing window in frames - mode : birdeye # rise up for a top-down reveal of the whole scene frames : [1500, 1800] reveal_height_mult : 2.5 # birdeye height = scene scale × this factor - mode : follow # drop back into chase cam frames : [1800, -1] back_offset : 0.3 up_offset : 0.08 look_offset : 0.4 transition controls how many frames are blended between adjacent segments; frames: [0, -1] means "the whole sequence".
paragraphs.zh: camera : fov : 60.0 # 相机视场角（单位：度）transition : 30 # 相邻片段之间混合的帧数 segments : - mode : follow # 跟随输入轨迹的追踪镜头 frames : [0, 1500] # 该片段覆盖的渲染帧范围（-1 = 结尾） back_offset : 0.3 # 位于输入相机后方的距离（场景尺度的比例） up_offset : 0.08 # 高于输入相机的垂直抬升量 look_offset : 0.4 # 注视目标向前方延伸的距离 smooth_window : 30 # 轨迹平滑窗口（单位：帧） - mode : birdeye # 上升以俯视展现整个场景 frames : [1500, 1800] reveal_height_mult : 2.5 # 俯视高度 = 场景尺度 × 此系数 - mode : follow # 回落到追踪镜头 frames : [1800, -1] back_offset : 0.3 up_offset : 0.08 look_offset : 0.4 transition 控制相邻片段之间混合多少帧；frames: [0, -1] 表示“整个序列”。

paragraphs.en: camera : fov : 60.0 segments : - mode : follow frames : [0, -1] back_offset : 0.3 up_offset : 0.08 look_offset : 0.4 smooth_window : 30 Full birdeye (good for overview / hero shots):
paragraphs.zh: camera : fov : 60.0 segments : - mode : follow frames : [0, -1] back_offset : 0.3 up_offset : 0.08 look_offset : 0.4 smooth_window : 30 全景鸟瞰（适合总览画面 / 英雄镜头）：

paragraphs.en: camera : fov : 60.0 segments : - mode : birdeye frames : [0, -1] reveal_height_mult : 2.5 Follow with birdeye inserts : just list multiple segments in order under segments: — adjacent segments are interpolated using transition frames.
paragraphs.zh: camera : fov : 60.0 segments : - mode : birdeye（鸟瞰）frames : [0, -1] reveal_height_mult : 2.5 Follow with birdeye inserts（跟随并插入鸟瞰镜头）：只需在 segments: 下按顺序列出多个片段——相邻片段将使用过渡帧进行插值。

paragraphs.en: Caveat: when --config loads a YAML preset, passing any segment-shaping CLI flag ( --camera_mode , --back_offset , --up_offset , --look_offset , --smooth_window , --follow_scale_frames , --birdeye_start , --birdeye_duration , --reveal_height_mult ) discards the YAML's segments and rebuilds the camera path from those flags instead. To stay fully YAML-driven, don't pass any of them on the command line.
paragraphs.zh: 注意事项：当 --config 加载 YAML 预设时，如果传入任何用于塑造分段的命令行标志（--camera_mode、--back_offset、--up_offset、--look_offset、--smooth_window、--follow_scale_frames、--birdeye_start、--birdeye_duration、--reveal_height_mult），将会丢弃 YAML 中的分段设置，并改为根据这些标志重新构建相机路径。 若要完全由 YAML 驱动，请不要在命令行中传入其中任何一个标志。
